name: Document Maker
description: Generates PDF documents from HTML templates using Playwright.

commands.generate_pdf: Converts HTML content to a PDF file and returns the file path.

function.name: DOCS__generate_pdf
function.description: Generates a PDF document from a template ID or raw HTML. Use this when the user asks to create a magazine, report, or PDF document. Returns the absolute path of the generated PDF file, which can then be attached to emails or sent via messengers.

html_content.description: Optional: Raw HTML content to convert to PDF. If provided, template_id is ignored.

template_id.description: Optional: The ID of an existing template to render and convert to PDF.

template_vars.description: Optional: JSON string of variables to inject into the template if template_id is used.

filename.description: Optional: Desired name for the output PDF (e.g. 'magazine.pdf'). If not provided, a random UUID name will be used.

slash_commands.description: Genera un documento PDF da un testo HTML o da un template Hecos
